- **Add todos** — input field + Add button, also submits on Enter; empty input is rejected

conversation.contentPreview:
Build a Todo app in a single self-contained HTML file. Requirements:
- Add new todos
- Mark todos as complete (strikethrough)
- Delete todos
- Filter: All / Active / Completed
- Persist to localStorage

Deliver only the HTML file with JS, CSS, HTML. Use file name "todo_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html"

{"path": "todo_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html", "edit_description": "Create a NEW single self-contained HTML file named todo_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html implementing a complete Todo app. Everything (HTML, CSS, JS) must be inline in this one file — no external resources, no CDN links.

REQUIRED FEATURES (all must work):
1. Add new todos: a text input at the top with an "Add" button; pressing Enter in the input also adds. Trim whitespace; ignore empty input. After adding, clear the input and keep focus on it.
2. Mark todos as complete: each todo item has a checkbox; toggling it marks the todo completed and applies a strikethrough style (text-decoration: line-through) plus a muted/gray color to the text.
3. Delete todos: each item has a delete (×) button that removes it.
4. Filters: three buttons "All", "Active", "Completed". Clicking one filters the visible list and highlights the active filter button (aria-pressed or an .active class). The filter only affects display, not stored data.
5. Persist to localStorage: save the full todos array (JSON) under key "todos" after every change (add/toggle/delete). On page load, read and render from localStorage; handle missing/corrupt data gracefully (fall back to empty array, wrap JSON.parse in try/catch).

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Data model: array of objects { id, text, completed }. Use Date.now() + Math.random() or crypto-like unique id generation for id.
- Render function re-renders the <ul> list from state each time; use textContent (not innerHTML) for todo text to avoid XSS.
- Show an item counter like "N item(s) left" counting incomplete todos (nice-to-have but include it).
- Show an empty-state message ("No todos yet" or similar) when the filtered list is empty.
- Semantic HTML: header, main, form for adding (use submit event with preventDefault), ul/li for the list.
- Modern, clean CSS in a <style> tag in <head>: centered card layout (max-width ~480px), system font stack, subtle shadows, rounded corners, hover states on buttons, completed items styled with line-through and gray, responsive enough for mobile. Use a pleasant accent color (e.g. indigo/violet gradient header or accent buttons).
- Vanilla JS in a <script> tag at the end of <body>. No frameworks. Wrap in an IIFE or use 'use strict'. Code in English with clear comments.
- Include <!DOCTYPE html>, <html lang="en">, <meta charset="UTF-8">, viewport meta, and <title>Todo App</title>.

The file must be fully functional when opened directly in a browser via file:// protocol."}
